name: Invoice Tokenization (TReDS)
description: A TReDS-style receivable tokenized as fractional fungible units (modelled on the M1xchange POC). Each approved invoice is tokenized into fungible units (ERC-20) that a holder lists at a discount for financiers to buy; the invoice fingerprint (hash of invoice no + buyer + currency + amount + due date) is enforced unique so an invoice is tokenized only once. Sensitive documents stay off-ledger (the token carries a document URL and the document hash). Holders are KYC-verified, India-jurisdiction financiers on an allowlist; transfer = assignment of financed units; burn = repayment at maturity closes the lifecycle; freeze = default/dispute hold.

invoiceHash.description: Server-derived cryptographic fingerprint of (invoice no + buyer + currency + amount + due date) — enforced unique so an invoice is tokenized only once

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice No as raised by the seller

buyerName.description: Buyer Name (the corporate obligor who pays at maturity)

status.description: ERP status — only 'Available' invoices are eligible for tokenization

invoiceDocUrl.description: Invoice PDF — upload it or link the off-ledger document vault (only the hash lives on-ledger)

invoiceDocHash.description: SHA-256 of the uploaded invoice document (pins the off-ledger doc)
